Name: Aimon's Small Swamp Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][i][color=#fff2cc]A small swamp themed map with some special tweaks and features.[/color][/i][/font][/size][/center]
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][i][size=3]
This mod adds a relatively small sized custom farm, with lots of water and swampy decor. Comes with Hot Spring Grove![/size]
[/i][/font]
[quote][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][i][b]Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/mods]LooneyLuny[/url] who commissioned me for this map and encouraged me to upload it on Nexus! If you like witchy and cozy mods, you should definitely[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny/mods] check out their mod page![/url][/b][/i][/font][/size][/quote][/center]
[center][font=Trebuchet MS]
[i][b] [size=3] [u]Want Something bigger?[/u] Try  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41253]Big Swamp Farm[/url]﻿![/size][/b][/i][/font]
[line]
[/center]
[center][b][u][u][img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img] [/u][/u][/b][/center]

[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Farm Map:[/size][/color][/font]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Overgrown Swamp themed farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Visual effects: mist and shadow overlays, as well als dynamic lightrays and firefiles[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Custom starter Giftbox: Choose starting bonus items before creating a new save file (available in mod's configs).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] Better Farm fishing: catch different fish types in farm, depends on water type (mountain and forest/river pools are available).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Map Shortcuts: pathways Secret Woods and Grandpha's Shed (if SVE is installed) .[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Unlockable Minecart: get access to vanilla minecart system right from your farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Docks with boats: fast travel across the map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Respawnable forage (forest forage and mushrooms)[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Hot Spring Grove:[/size][/color][/b][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Hot Spring: swim in the lake and restore energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Small Quarry area: ore and gede nodes will spawn here.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Shrine of Night Terrors: sacrifice a special item to the shrine so monsters will spawn in farm! More info about it here:   [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Dark_Shrine_of_Night_Terrors]*Click*[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Respawnable forest forage.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][b][b][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Pathway to Hot Spring Grove is located at to left corner of the map, see [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/27631/27631-1792934588-58154359.gif]screenshots[/url] for visual info.[/font][/size][/color][/b][/b]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] Most features are configurable - feel free to open the mod's config menu and tweak it as you like!   [/font][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod [/url]for more convenient ingame config.[/font][/size][/b][/center]
[line]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Recommended mods:[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27656]Luny's Purple Swamp Fields[/url] - adds matching witchy grass for the farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]BogWyytch's mods[/url] - if you're looking for witchy foilage, buildings and other retextures retextures.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url] - if you you're looking for witchy themed recolor that affects all maps and locations.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Build and Place Anything Anywhere[/url] - to ease up farm planning, since it is kinda tidy in some places.[/font][/size]
[line]
[/*]
[/list][center][url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url][/center]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]New Save File Options[/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Starter Gift[/b] - Changes items you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose before creating new save file.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Starter Giftbox items available: [/size]
[spoiler][quote][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS] [/font][/size][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]﻿﻿- Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿﻿﻿- Swamping- will give you 30 Rice Sprout Seeds, 1 Recycling Machine, 1 Cauldron (furniture), 1 Witch Broom (furniture) and 1 Witch Hat
-  Foraging -  will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing -  will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating -  will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿ - Mining - will give you 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item
﻿- Ranching -  will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿ ﻿- Floristing -  will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿- Jojaing -  ???  [/font][/size][/quote][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Recolor Options:[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Farm Recolor:[/b]  true/false    - Enables swamp themed dirt and grass recolor in farm. Toggle it to 'false' if you want to use other recolor mod so it will affect farm map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hot Spring Grove Recolor:[/b]  true/false    - Enables swamp themed dirt and grass recolor in Hot Spring Grove map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Recolor Style:[/b] Green / Purple    - Recolor style for dirt, grass, trees and foliage in farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Bog's Fall Recolor: [/b]true/false    - Optional recolor for dirt and grass in Fall season.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Kat's Mild Winter Recolor:[/b] true/false    - Winter-only recolor in style of Kat's Mild Winter Recolor mod.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Visuals Options: [/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Mist Effect:[/b] Always / Night and Rain / Only Rai / None    - Adds mist overlay in Farm and Hot Spring Grove[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Shadow Overlay:[/b] true/false    -  Adds shadow overlay in Farm and Hot Spring Grove.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Bubble Effect:[/b] true/false     - Adds animated bubbles on water.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]MMAP Visual Effects Options: [/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Dynamic Lightrays:[/b] true/false     - Adds animated lightrays in Farm and Hot Spring Grove.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Fireflies:[/b] true/false     - Adds firefly critters in Farm and Hot Spring Grove.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Map Tweaks Options: [/size][/color][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hot Spring Grove:[/b] true/false     - Adds pathway to Hot Spring Grove map in top left corner of Farm map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Minecart:[/b] true/false     - Adds working minecart to Farm which is connected with vanilla minecart system.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]More Land: [/b]true/false     -  Removes some parts of rivers in the middle of Farm map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Water Holes for Paddy Crops:[/b] true/false     -  Adds extra water tiles on the island in bottom left corner of the map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Small Pond:[/b] true/false    - Adds small pond near the farmhouse.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]SVE Grandpha's Shed Shortcut[/b]: true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Secret Woods Shortcut:[/b] true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffe599][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Don't want respawnable forage in farm?[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Go to folder: Aimon's Small Swamp Farm - Custom Farm\[FTM] Small Swamp Farm [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Open content.json file with any text editor.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Find "ForageSpawnEnabled" string on top part of the document and change it to "false"[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Save the changes.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Done![/font][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[center]
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible [/color][/b]with recolors and retextures. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599]Compatible[/color][/b] with PolyCarts and other minecart mods, but you need to manually disable minecart in PolyCart's config for Farm map.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#e06666]Not compatible[/color][/b] with any other mod that edits the Foraging Farm (if you use Vanilla Wilderness Farm replacement version)[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#ffe599]Note[/color][/u][/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url] may affect how water looks in farm (I used Teal, Semi-Opaque option on my screenshots).[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#ffe599]Note for SVE compatibility[/color][/u][/b] - the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is x = 89, y = 11 - change it in SVE config.[/font][/size]
[line]
[center][/center]
[center][b][i][u][color=#ffe599][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/size] [/color][/u][/i][/b][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][i][u][color=#ffe599]Note:[/color] [/u][/i]there's 2 versions of this mod:[/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Custom Version -  [/b]adds new swamp farm as custom farm (does not affect vanilla Wilderness farm).[/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b] Vanilla Version - [/b]one works as replacement for vanilla Wilderness farm.
If you start new game -  using Custom version is recommended in order to avoid issues with other farm mods.[/font][/size][/center]

[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Installation steps:[/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Unzip "Aimon's Small Swamp Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Enjoy![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][center][line]
